decisions.rationale: Division is the classificatory noun; the source has no extra non-virtues noun at this position.
Exact ordinal second, excluding the English the and source bound genitive.
Local object of the second class, excluding supplied their. The unrelated auto-mined gzhi gloss is not promoted.
First noun denotes the general enjoyments class, not the later enjoyment action or anaphoric final certain enjoyments.
The overt copula is recast as have in this English object-as-enjoyments construction; have is in the full HGM yin record. As their is distributed framing and is not assigned again.
The complete living-being term names the locus of physical sensation; preserve the singular and exclude a.
The whole internal-location expression is exactly HGM within, functioning as a relation. The preceding gyi and following source syntax do not yield extra English atoms.
Full technical object-of-touch term has exact HGM physical sensations. Do not split reg/physical and bya/sensations.
This object relation is recast as enjoyment in the form of physical sensations; bank only in, leaving the form of expansion outside.
The full action form is exact HGM enjoyment. It is the second Tibetan enjoyment expression, distinct from the initial plural noun.
Causal/ablative las links occurrence to enjoyment, rendered through. The curated deeds sense is not used as this particle.
The coordinator introduces the alternative causal case, rendered or; the full particle record explicitly includes or. No additive and is invented.
Second la marks the object of taking possession, recast as the of after possession. It is distinct from the earlier enjoyment in relation and from of within by force of.
Full possessive-taking compound has exact HGM taking possession. Exclude the English possessor one's and object of certain enjoyments.
The taking/holding member is directly HGM taking and is strictly tighter than taking possession. No independently unattested bdag tu/possession child is fabricated.
Use the complete causal idiom at d6, explicitly HGM by force of. It keeps whole agentive gis and the force relation together rather than splitting an attached s.

omissions.reason: The two Tibetan cause clauses share one fronted English occurrence predicate. Its exclusive lexical allocation is not uniquely established; omit both rather than duplicate occur or falsely null the second.

The demonstrative refers back to enjoyments and is expanded as a lexical noun phrase in English. Banking de as enjoyments would misrepresent a pronoun as that dictionary noun; keep the anaphoric recast unbanked.
